description: This file defines classes and functions for shape and tensor metadata propagation within PyTorch's FX graph framework, including the TensorMetadata data structure and the ShapeProp interpreter class that records tensor shapes and types during graph execution.

classes.name: TensorMetadata
classes.description: A NamedTuple storing metadata about a tensor, including shape, dtype, requires_grad, stride, memory_format, and quantization parameters.

classes.name: ShapeProp
classes.description: An FX interpreter subclass that propagates shape and type information through a graph, recording tensor metadata in node annotations.

methods.name: _extract_tensor_metadata
methods.description: Extracts tensor metadata from a torch.Tensor object, including shape, dtype, stride, memory format, and quantization info.

methods.name: run_node
methods.description: Executes a graph node, records tensor metadata if tensors are produced, and handles fake tensor modes.

methods.name: propagate
methods.description: Runs the module with sample inputs, recording shape and type information for each node.
